parameters.name: EndpointType
parameters.description: The type of the endpoint. Set the value to Internet.

parameters.name: Entry
parameters.description: The CIDR block that is accessible.

parameters.name: ModuleName
parameters.description:
The name of the module that you want to access. Valid values:

*   `Registry`: the image repository.
*   `Chart`: a Helm chart.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr create-instance-endpoint-acl-policy --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --biz-endpoint-type internet --entry 192.168.1.1/32 --comment test --module-name Registry --entries example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr CreateInstanceEndpointAclPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Comment test --Entry '192.168.1.1/32' --InstanceId 'cri-xkx6vujuhay00000' --ModuleName Registry --EndpointType internet --Entries '["example-string"]'
